name: exercise_3_4
informal_prefix: /-- Show that $ \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} \frac{x \sin x}{x^2 + a^2} dx = \pi e^{-a}$ for $a > 0$.-/
formal_statement:
theorem exercise_3_4 (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    Tendsto (λ y => ∫ x in -y..y, x * Real.sin x / (x ^ 2 + a ^ 2))
    atTop (𝓝 (Real.pi * (Real.exp (-a)))) :=
goal:
a : ℝ
ha : 0 < a
⊢ Tendsto (fun y => ∫ (x : ℝ) in -y..y, x * x.sin / (x ^ 2 + a ^ 2)) atTop (𝓝 (Real.pi * (-a).exp))
